scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=web & npm run dev --workspace=api & wait
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=web && npm run lint --workspace=api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=web && npm run test --workspace=api
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:3001 -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Ports 3001 and 5173 freed'
scripts.db:migrate: cd prisma && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd prisma && npx prisma db seed
